title: Exec Pocket Briefing — Sprint Notes
body:
Meeting: Exec staff weekly (compact slot) — objective: aligned decisions on capacity commits, security checklist for private pilot, and cross-org hiring taps.
Date/time: Mar 11, 2026 / 09:00–09:40 PT (compact 40m)
Attendees (for planning): CEO, CTO (virtual), VP Eng (Eleanor), VP Product, Head of SRE, Head of Sales (brief), Aisha (owner of notes)

Top objectives (three):
- Decide: greenlight additional Dedicated reserve for Q2 burst (+20% capacity) or approve staged canary scaling plan (preferred lower-cost path).
- Decide: sign-off on security gating for first Private pilot customer (legal checklist + isolated KMS).
- Action: agree on a 1-week cross-functional task list to unblock hiring for infra SRE "on-call" slot.

Quick one-liners to open:
- "This meeting is tightly scoped — two decisions and a short action plan. For anything not decided we’ll capture an owner and a day-3 playbook."
- "If we hit time, we’ll surface any blockers on the private pilot checklist and defer tactical staffing details to Slack async."

Background/context (two-paragraph):
- Capacity: Observed Q1 burst patterns exceed forecasted 95th percentile by ~18% for the 2–4 PM PT window; current Dedicated pool cover is sufficient for steady-state but not for sustained bursts tied to partner tests. Finance prefers staged delta to avoid committing extra monthly until partner pilot succeeds. Also we can mitigate with transient burst credits and temporary cross-region routing.
- Private pilot: Customer (NimbleHealth) requires on-prem-style audit path (KMS separation, additional logging retention). Legal has flagged two items re: data residency; security completed a gap analysis and recommends a short opt-in checklist + an environment freeze for pilot. Timeline requested: pilot sign-off and infra ready in 3 weeks.

Decision asks (framing + options):
1) Dedicated reserve increase: Approve A or B?
   A) Approve +20% reserve now (fast, more cost)
   B) Approve staged 2-step (10% immediate, auto-burst rule for additional 10% if 5-day sustained >= 80% util) — recommended
   C) Defer while we test routing + cache tweaks (risk: potential throttles during partner test)
2) Private pilot gating: Approve checklist now or require additional audit?
   - Approve minimal checklist from Security (KMS separation, 90-day log retention, audit hooks) + legal addendum
   - Ask Security to run a deeper pen test before rollout (adds 2–3 weeks)

Proposed script for presenting capacity ask (one paragraph):
- "We observed a sustained 18% uplift in the afternoon window driven by two partner tests and organic traffic. Our staged plan (B) reduces long-term spend while providing capacity during the pilot by enabling short-term burst triggers. If approved, infra will implement the burst rule and Finance will model the monthly delta for reporting."

Metrics snapshot (to paste in meeting):
- 90-day 95th percentile GPU utilization (prod-serving pool): 64% -> 76% during test windows
- Avg token latency (p50/p95): 42ms / 220ms -> spikes to 350ms at peak
- Token cost delta estimate for +20% reserve: +$43k/month (model attached in Confluence)

Red flags / callouts (bulleted):
- Customer timeline is aggressive — legal asks may push pilot date beyond their preferred window.
- If we choose full +20% reserve, we should concurrently enable auto-fallback to lower-cost quantized model family for non-critical routes.
- SRE on-call bandwidth is thin during the week of Mar 22 (hiring slot open).

Open questions (notes-to-self / agenda additions):
- Are there any objections from Sales to staged approach if we surface a mid-pilot billing adjustment? (ask Head of Sales directly)
- Can Platform team commit to the burst-rule change within 48h of approval? (quick sync with Miguel)

Proposed follow-ups / action list (owner + due):
- Aisha: Draft short email to partner explaining staged reserve option and expectation (due: Mar 12)
- Eleanor (VP Eng): Confirm feasibility of 48h burst-rule implementation and identify any infra risks (due: Mar 13)
- Miguel (Platform Eng): Create a short runbook for auto-fallback to quantized variant and test in canary (due: Mar 18)
- Benji (Security): Finalize minimal pilot checklist and produce a one-page summary for legal (due: Mar 14)
- Head of SRE: Reassign on-call for Mar 22 week; post interim rota (due: Mar 15)

Notes to self / presenter's quick cues (bullet):
- Run through metrics snapshot first, then land the recommended option (staged).
- If CEO pushes for faster approval, emphasize mitigations (auto-fallback + region routing).
- Keep Private pilot gating binary: agree minimal checklist now OR delayed pen-test. Avoid multi-stage debate in live meeting.

Tactics for pushback (short):
- Finance cost concerns: show cost delta + savings if we enable auto-fallback (present quick 3-line model).
- Legal/security caution: offer a legal addendum and a 2-week soft-hold if needed to allow additional review.

Wrap / asks at end of meeting (script):
- "If we can agree on the staged reserve and the minimal security checklist, we’ll issue two immediate tasks: infra to implement the burst rule and security to publish the checklist for legal. Owners and due dates go into Asana and I’ll follow up with a 1-week readout."

Post-meeting packing list (what I’ll send within 24h):
- Final decisions summary + owners (one-pager)
- Links to runbooks and Confluence cost model
- Short note to partner with staged-reserve explanation

Unresolved items to track (backlog):
- Longer-term capacity modeling for Q3 (assign to Finance + Product)
- Quantization quality-eval across high-throughput customer routes (assign to Applied ML)

Tone notes / style: keep it short, pragmatic, and executive-focused; avoid technical deep-dive unless asked.

Scratch section (raw):
- quick Slack refs: #exec-ops -> convo id CF8K2, thread about partner billing adjustments.
- Quick doc refs: confluence page with cost model (linked above), PR#394 has preliminary infra changes for burst rules.
- Personal reminder: block Mar 16–17 for follow-up drafting and partner sync.

End of notes.

---
Revision history: 2025-11-05 initial outline; 2026-03-09 updated metrics and timelines; 2026-03-10 final pre-meeting polish (this draft).
